evidence.notes: DeletedRecord exposes the full Salesforce deletion Datetime.
GetUpdatedResult exposes the requested latest sync date as Date.

source.content: @isTest private class DatabaseDateReturnTypesTest { @isTest static void syncResultsUseSalesforceTypes() { Datetime deletedWindowStart = Datetime.now(); Account deletedAccount = new Account(Name = 'M6 Date Return'); insert deletedAccount; Id accountId = deletedAccount.Id; delete deletedAccount; Datetime deletedWindowEnd = Datetime.now().addMinutes(1); Database.GetDeletedResult observedDeleted = Database.getDeleted('Account', deletedWindowStart, deletedWindowEnd); Database.DeletedRecord deletedRecord; for (Database.DeletedRecord candidate : observedDeleted.getDeletedRecords()) { if (candidate.getId() == accountId) { deletedRecord = candidate; break; } } System.assertNotEquals(null, deletedRecord); Datetime deletedDate = deletedRecord.getDeletedDate(); System.assert(deletedDate >= deletedWindowStart.addMinutes(-1)); System.assert(deletedDate <= deletedWindowEnd); Date earliest = observedDeleted.getEarliestDateAvailable(); Date latest = observedDeleted.getLatestDateCovered(); if (earliest != null && latest != null) { System.assert(earliest <= latest); } Database.GetUpdatedResult updated = Database.getUpdated('Account', deletedWindowStart, deletedWindowEnd); Date updatedLatest = updated.getLatestDateCovered(); System.assertNotEquals(null, updatedLatest); } }
